column1: # tools/css/gen-color-tables.py: the color spaces of CSS Color 4 that the computed value of a color needs, as the draft defines them. Columns, tab separated:
# name, kind, white (d50 or d65), r.x, r.y, g.x, g.y, b.x, b.y (primaries of an RGB space, else -), transfer (srgb, gamma, prophoto, rec2020, linear, none), source.
# The matrices are derived by the generator from the primaries and the white point with exact rational arithmetic (Color 4, "Converting from RGB to XYZ": the
# matrix is made from the chromaticities of the primaries and of the white point), then rounded once to a double; nothing here is a transcription of digits.
# The white points are those of Color 4: D50 (0.3457, 0.3585) and D65 (0.3127, 0.3290). Lab, LCH, Oklab and Oklch have no primaries: their constants are in the

column11: Color 4, 10.2 (srgb) and the chromaticities of sRGB
Color 4, 10.3 (display-p3): the sRGB transfer function with the P3 primaries
Color 4, 10.5 (prophoto-rgb): gamma 1.8 with a linear segment below 1/512
Color 4, 10.8 (rec2020): the pure power 2.4 of Rec. ITU-R BT.1886, not the piecewise curve
